Three up-and-coming founders pitch their real Seed and/or Series A round, plus one hilariously FAKE business concept. It's the ultimate test of grit, creativity, and charm.

description: empowHER is a community and platform that unites ambitious women to empower, collaborate, and succeed together. Featuring a panel discussion with inspiring leaders and a yoga sculpt session.

Mike is an SEO icon, the founder of iPullRank, and the pioneer of SEO Week. He'll be speaking on the role of Generative AI and its implications on search engines. This is a casual, friendly evening designed to connect SEOs to further learning and relationship building.

Looking forward to seeing you there:)

name: Shred: Sweat for Medical Debt Relief at The Garage
address: 2501 W Chicago Ave, Chicago, IL 60622, USA

Every $1 raised can erase $146 of medical debt, helping patients and families regain financial stability. Join The Garage Chicago for a workout that's about more than just showing up, it's about showing up for others.
